# Parity

> Parity is a free online speedcubing timer for the Rubik's Cube and other WCA puzzles. It gives random-state scrambles, shows a 3D preview that scrambles itself, keeps sessions with WCA-style averages, and includes a PLL, OLL, 2-look and F2L trainer. It runs entirely in the browser, needs no account, and keeps solves on the user's device.

## Main pages

- [Timer](__SITE_URL__/#timer): the cube timer with scramble, 3D preview, current ao5 and session statistics.
- [Trainer](__SITE_URL__/#trainer): drill PLL (21 cases), OLL (57), 2-look OLL (10), 2-look PLL (6) and F2L (41) with real setup scrambles.
- [Stats](__SITE_URL__/#stats): best single and averages, progression chart, time distribution, sub-X milestones, practice calendar.
- [Guide](__SITE_URL__/#guide): how the timer, inspection, averages, scrambles and trainer work, with an FAQ.

## Key facts

- Events: 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 One-Handed, 3x3 Blindfolded, Pyraminx, Skewb, Megaminx, Clock, Square-1.
- Scrambles: random state for 3x3 (two-phase solver, about 21 moves), 2x2 (optimal, at least 4 moves), Pyraminx (at least 6 moves plus tips), Skewb (at least 7 moves) and Clock. Random move for 4x4 to 7x7, Megaminx (Pochmann notation) and Square-1.
- Timer: hold space until green, release to start, any key stops. Optional 15-second WCA inspection with +2 after 15 seconds and DNF after 17.
- Averages: ao5 and ao12 drop the best and worst solve; ao50 and ao100 drop 5% from each end; mo3 is a plain mean; a DNF counts as the worst time.
- Data: stored in the browser's local storage. Users can export a JSON backup and import csTimer exports.
- Cost: free, no ads, no sign-up.
- Not affiliated with Rubik's Brand Ltd or the World Cube Association.
